entities.summary: Juan Carlos Montiel is a retired male boxer from Uruguay. He competed for his native country at the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul, South Korea, and won a bronze medal at the 1987 Pan American Games during his career as an amateur. Nicknamed "Tito" he made his professional debut on October 15, 1993, defeating Luiz Augusto Ferreira. Juan Montiel was a athletes & competitors from Montevideo (b. 1965-11-12, Montevideo).
